library_supplier_contracts.inspected_contract: For every norm-compact set in a Banach space and every epsilon, a bounded finite-rank operator uniformly approximates the identity; BAP adds a fixed operator-norm bound. No approximating sequence is required.
Under Dependent Choice, a Banach space with a Schauder basis has K-BAP, hence AP; use only after a basis is established.
Under AC, reflexivity plus AP gives MAP. Not required by Theorem 11 because AP is sufficient.
Every compact linear T:X→Y is operator-norm approximable by finite-rank maps if the Banach target Y has AP. It does not cover arbitrary Y or nonlinear G-dagger.
Under Countable Choice and Dependent Choice, a uniformly bounded/equicontinuous family in C(K,R) on compact metric K has compact closure; apply at k=0 to bounded Holder residuals.
Under AC, W^{k,p}(Omega) is Banach for open Omega, integer k≥0 and 1≤p≤infinity; supports H1/W12 space notation.

Under AC and Countable Choice, on an open set bounded in one direction, the principal uniformly elliptic divergence-form sesquilinear form is coercive on H1_0. It covers only the principal part; ML36 derives source lower-order terms locally.

Requires a bounded C^{2,alpha} domain, nondivergence coefficients in C^{0,alpha}, boundary data C^{2,alpha}, and an injectivity premise on the homotopy. It does not cover the source exterior-sphere domain/continuous boundary-data theorem.
For classical subsolutions of the heat operator u_t-Delta u on bounded parabolic cylinders. No variable-coefficient drift/diffusion interface is supplied.
